header: Choose which cookies the portal may set
content: The customer portal needs one cookie to keep you signed in. Everything beyond that is your decision: we count which technical documents get opened, and the plant tour videos load a player that sets cookies of its own. Choose per category below and change it later from the footer.

cookie_categories.name: Sign-in and configurator
cookie_categories.description_text: Keeps your session and your parts configurator selection for twelve hours.

cookie_categories.name: Document analytics
cookie_categories.description_text: Counts which drawings and certificates are downloaded. Hosted on our own servers in Graz, no third party involved.

cookie_categories.name: Plant tour videos
cookie_categories.description_text: Loads the embedded player, which sets its own cookies once you press play.
